fixtureInputs.bundleArchiveHandling: Harmless fixture source retained privately; its literal-only inert contents are described in the authority. No archive download is implied.

stateCoverage.method: Real production Agent Canvas and pinned Local backend in separate owned private runs; exact state and source selection are in paired-source-selection.json. No UI mock, route interception or state injection.

reproductionSequence: Use the recorded exact source/build identities, committed lock and pinned Local services in an isolated private verification run.
Arrange the harmless saved but unused model profiles, idle tagged conversation without initial message/autotitle, and INACTIVE literal-only bundle fixture described in the authority.
Exercise the frozen named Prompt/Custom, menu/dialog, schedule, grid, resize/scroll, route/dock, theme and viewport states using real UI interaction.
Record normal native action timing and capture stills plus read-only computed role properties. Keep the sidebar counter outside the setup-role comparison; fixture arrangement order differed.
Confirm no model, message, dispatch or enabled schedule execution, remove only owned fixtures, stop the owned stack and verify its actual owned ports are closed.

mediaRecipe.ambience: Original generated quiet sine pad, approximately -52.5 dBFS; not application audio.
mediaRecipe.encode: Independent per-scene decoders feed one continuous limited-range H264 yuv420p encode; AAC and faststart. No stream-copy concatenation.
mediaRecipe.seekVerification: Every scene start/middle/end independently sought and compared pixel-for-pixel to a single continuous decode.

limitations: Selected computed roles and geometry are compared; no whole-page pixel identity is asserted.
Native recordings have independent actual clocks and action durations.
The unrelated sidebar setup-progress count can differ because fixture arrangement timing differs; it is outside the selected setup-role comparison.
Real live UI evidence is standalone Canvas. Actual app/library CSS snapshots and compiled library contract receipts establish delivery; no separate live embedded host was launched.
Only layout states in the frozen manifests were exercised; no model, provider, dispatch or schedule behavior is claimed.
No connected Git provider, remote repository clone, webhook, Cloud/MARS account, model response or agent-assisted form-update behavior was tested.
Known Escape and draft-Test defects were not retested, modified or retired.
Original pixels visibly contain benign owned QA/profile names and inert bundle UUIDs. Public JSON sanitizes private identifiers; the original PNG/MP4 pixels remain unredacted.
Generated code displays literal environment-variable names and Bearer syntax, not resolved credential values.
Native clips retain the recorder-produced MP4 cadence, including CLI still lead-in trimming/final holds. All recorder statistics, including zero misses, are retained.
The final PR has a test-only descendant head. Captured checkout/app and library identities remain exact and are bound through final-pr-source-binding.json.
